field_descriptions.end_date: The end date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.merchant_return_days: Specifies either a fixed return date or the number of days (from the delivery date) that a product can be returned. Used when the [[returnPolicyCategory]] property is specified as [[MerchantReturnFiniteReturnWindow]].
field_descriptions.refund_type: A refund type, from an enumerated list.
field_descriptions.restocking_fee: Use [[MonetaryAmount]] to specify a fixed restocking fee for product returns, or use [[Number]] to specify a percentage of the product price paid by the customer.
field_descriptions.return_fees: The type of return fees for purchased products (for any return reason).
field_descriptions.return_method: The type of return method offered, specified from an enumeration.
field_descriptions.return_policy_category: Specifies an applicable return policy (from an enumeration).
field_descriptions.return_shipping_fees_amount: Amount of shipping costs for product returns (for any reason). Applicable when property [[returnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].
field_descriptions.start_date: The start date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).
